title: Energy Cleansing Wall Hanger
shortDescription: Crafted as an energy cleansing masterpiece.

categoryData.details: Crafted as an energy cleansing masterpiece, this creation harnesses the potent symbolism of the triangle shape to invoke balance. Two meticulously chosen crystals adorn the piece, each serving as a conduit to purify and dispel negative energies within the space it inhabits.
